name: MonarchOnboardingChecklist
title: OnboardingChecklist
summary: A first-run checklist: steps with a done state and an optional call to action, a progress summary, and collapse and dismiss controls.
whenToUse: To guide people through setting up a product with a short list of steps (three to seven) that the app can mark done from its own data.
whenNotToUse: For a linear form split into pages use MonarchStepper. For a to-do list people tick themselves use MonarchCheckboxRow.
api: @Composable fun MonarchOnboardingChecklist(title: String, steps: List<MonarchOnboardingStep>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, description: String? = null, completeMessage: String? = null, collapsible: Boolean = true, expanded: Boolean? = null, onExpandedChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, onDismiss: (() -> Unit)? = null, expandIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, dismissIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, doneIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchOnboardingChecklistLabels = MonarchOnboardingChecklistLabels(), action: (@Composable (MonarchOnboardingStep) -> Unit)? = null)
class MonarchOnboardingStep(id: String, title: String, description: String? = null, done: Boolean = false)

class MonarchOnboardingChecklistLabels(progress: ((done: Int, total: Int) -> String)? = null, progressLabel: String? = null, dismiss: String? = null, done: String? = null, notDone: String? = null, current: String? = null, complete: String? = null, expanded: String? = null, collapsed: String? = null)

options.name: title
options.description: The heading, such as "Get started". Read as a heading.

options.name: steps
options.description: The steps in order: id, title, optional description and done. The app decides when each is done.

options.name: completeMessage
options.description: Replaces "All done. You are set up.", shown when every step is done.

options.name: collapsible
options.description: Makes the progress row a MonarchCollapsible header that shows and hides the steps.

options.name: expanded
options.description: Whether the steps are shown. null lets the checklist keep the state itself (saved across configuration changes), starting expanded. Hoist it to keep the state across launches.

options.name: onExpandedChange
options.description: Called with the new state when the user uses the progress row.

options.name: onDismiss
options.description: Shows a dismiss button that calls this. The app hides the checklist and remembers it.

options.name: expandIcon
options.description: An icon after the progress text, such as a chevron pointing down; it turns half a turn while expanded.

options.name: dismissIcon
options.description: An icon for the dismiss button, such as a close mark. Without it the button shows its label.

options.name: doneIcon
options.description: A check mark drawn in the marker of a done step and before the complete message.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings: progress, progressLabel, dismiss, done, notDone, current, complete, expanded and collapsed.

options.name: action
options.description: The call to action of a step, such as a small MonarchButton. Shown under the step text only while the step is not done.

states.name: in progress
states.description: The bar and "n of m done" show progress; the first open step has the subtle fill and an accent ring around its number.

states.name: step done
states.description: The marker is a filled success circle (with doneIcon when given); the title is muted; the description and action are hidden.

states.name: complete
states.description: Every step is done: a success message (with doneIcon when given) appears above the steps.

states.name: collapsed
states.description: Only the heading, the bar and the progress row are shown; the expand icon turns back.

states.name: empty
states.description: With no steps the progress reads "0 of 0 done" and the checklist is not complete.

appearance: A MonarchCard (surface fill, subtle border). The progress uses MonarchProgress (accent fill on the emphasis track). Open steps have a number in a strong-border ring, the current step an accent-strong ring on the subtle row fill, done steps a success-solid circle with content in the on-solid color. The complete message uses the success subtle fill and success strong text. All are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow the theme.
platformNotes: Kotlin names follow Material 3: done instead of isDone, collapsible instead of isCollapsible, and expanded as a nullable value with onExpandedChange in place of an optional Binding. The action is a nullable trailing lambda instead of a second initialiser. Monarch for Android bundles no icons, so the chevron, close mark and check are slots (expandIcon, dismissIcon, doneIcon); without dismissIcon the dismiss button shows its label as a ghost button, and without doneIcon a done step is a filled circle, which differs from the numbered ring by shape and by its spoken state. The web turns the progress bar to the success tone when complete; MonarchProgress has no tone, so the bar stays accent and the success message shows completion. The web sets a heading level; Android marks the title as a heading without a level. The web places the action beside the step on wide screens; Android places it under the step text. The progress row is MonarchCollapsible, so its spoken name is the progress text rather than "Setup progress"; the bar itself carries "Setup progress" with the progress text as its state.
accessibility: The progress bar is named "Setup progress" and its state is "n of m done" instead of a percentage.

With collapsing, the progress row is one button read as "n of m done" with the state "Expanded" or "Collapsed" and the TalkBack expand and collapse actions; hidden steps leave the screen and are not reached.
Without collapsing, the visible progress text is not read again; the progress bar carries it.
Each step is one element read as its title and description, with the state "Done" or "Not done" ("Not done, Current step" for the first open step); the step number and marker are not read.
Each step's action is a separate element after the step.
Done is shown by a filled marker in place of the numbered ring and by the spoken state, not by color alone.
The dismiss button is named "Dismiss checklist" (its visible label, or the spoken name of the icon form) and, like the progress row, has a 48dp touch target.
Markers grow with the font size and text wraps at font scale 2.0; the expand animation follows MonarchCollapsible and is removed when animations are off.
edgeCases: The checklist does not hide itself on dismiss; the app removes it.
Step ids must be unique; they key the rows.
An empty step list is never complete.
Long titles and descriptions wrap; the marker stays at the top of the step.
The complete message is not announced when it appears; it is read in order with the steps.

examples.title: Get started
examples.template:
MonarchOnboardingChecklist(
    title = {{title}},
    steps = steps,
    description = {{description}},
    onDismiss = {},
    dismissIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Close, null) },
    doneIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Check, null) },
) { step ->
    when (step.id) {
        {{steps.1.id}} -> MonarchButton(text = {{steps.1.action.label}}, onClick = {}, variant = MonarchButtonVariant.{{steps.1.action.variant|pascal}}, size = MonarchButtonSize.Sm)
        {{steps.2.id}} -> MonarchButton(text = {{steps.2.action.label}}, onClick = {}, variant = MonarchButtonVariant.{{steps.2.action.variant|pascal}}, size = MonarchButtonSize.Sm)
        {{steps.3.id}} -> MonarchButton(text = {{steps.3.action.label}}, onClick = {}, variant = MonarchButtonVariant.{{steps.3.action.variant|pascal}}, size = MonarchButtonSize.Sm)
    }
}
examples.setupTemplate:
val steps = listOf(
    MonarchOnboardingStep(id = {{steps.0.id}}, title = {{steps.0.title}}, done = {{steps.0.done}}),
    MonarchOnboardingStep(id = {{steps.1.id}}, title = {{steps.1.title}}, description = {{steps.1.description}}),
    MonarchOnboardingStep(id = {{steps.2.id}}, title = {{steps.2.title}}, description = {{steps.2.description}}),
    MonarchOnboardingStep(id = {{steps.3.id}}, title = {{steps.3.title}}),
)
examples.setup:
val steps = listOf(
    MonarchOnboardingStep(id = "profile", title = "Complete your profile", done = true),
    MonarchOnboardingStep(id = "invite", title = "Invite your team", description = "Work is easier to share with the people you work with."),
    MonarchOnboardingStep(id = "project", title = "Create your first project", description = "Start from a template or a blank project."),
    MonarchOnboardingStep(id = "notifications", title = "Choose your notifications"),
)
examples.code:
MonarchOnboardingChecklist(
    title = "Get started",
    steps = steps,
    description = "A few steps to set up your workspace.",
    onDismiss = {},
    dismissIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Close, null) },
    doneIcon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Check, null) },
) { step ->
    when (step.id) {
        "invite" -> MonarchButton(text = "Invite people", onClick = {}, variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Secondary, size = MonarchButtonSize.Sm)
        "project" -> MonarchButton(text = "New project", onClick = {}, variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Secondary, size = MonarchButtonSize.Sm)
        "notifications" -> MonarchButton(text = "Open settings", onClick = {}, variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Ghost, size = MonarchButtonSize.Sm)
    }
}

examples.title: Expanded state kept by the screen
examples.code:
MonarchOnboardingChecklist(
    title = "Get started",
    steps = listOf(
        MonarchOnboardingStep(id = "a", title = "Verify your email", done = true),
        MonarchOnboardingStep(id = "b", title = "Add a payment method"),
    ),
    expanded = expanded,
    onExpandedChange = { expanded = it },
)
